summary: Soccer mini games! Play career mode: Score & be the next soccer superstar!
description:
Welcome to the MINI SOCCER STAR - 2026 USA CUP & MLS

Play the brand new soccer game Mini Soccer Star and enjoy the real and immersive soccer experience. Become the new soccer star player!

Make a name for yourself in the soccer world by playing football matches. Gain popularity and become the new soccer superstar!

Play matches in your dream league, strike and score goals, win the cup and become the world champion!

Our physics-based soccer simulation system gives you an amazing gaming experience.
There are tons of real teams and leagues/cups from mls, premier, bundes, la liga and even national teams. 
You can join the most famous European football clubs and play for usa country in the world league. Eventually you will become a football super star!

FEATURES: 
⚽ You can play offline soccer games
⚽ Lots of real soccer teams and leagues/cups
⚽ Career mode of a soccer player
⚽ Goalkeeper mode
⚽ Advanced animation system and AI
⚽ Super simple controls - just swipe and tap
⚽ Addictive soccer training challenges
⚽ Lots of player customization options
⚽ Save your big goals at any time
⚽ Stylized game graphics
⚽ Optimized game size to save your precious storage space
⚽ Google Play Services Achievements and Leaderboards
